text:
Olivia: Quick sync — we need to finalize the Launch Conductor checklist for the Helios pilot. Goal: canary next Tue. I want sequencing + owners for runtime prewarm, infra quota, security signoff, telemetry, and rollback. Who's in?
Mateo: I can own infra quota and autoscale policy. Need expected peak QPS and token/sec. Also confirm whether dedicated pool or shared burst.
Olivia: Peak ~450 QPS, ~180k tokens/min. Start with dedicated small pool (2x p4d-ish) + burst to shared.
Priya: Runtime: we'll need a prewarm job + KV cache priming. I can add a canary profile but need model variant list and sample prompts for prefix cache.
Olivia: Models: redwood-13b-8bit + redwood-7b-q4. Sample prompts in the drive (link) — will paste quick snippet below.
Sasha: FYI — Helios has two VIP tenant IDs: HLS-1001, HLS-1012. They want <150ms p95 for simple prompts.
Priya: Adding those tenant IDs to a 5% canary is fine. Also: recommend setting continuous-batching to medium (max_batch 32) for latency vs throughput tradeoff.
Jin: Infra question: do we need extra network egress rules for Helios? Security/SaaS egress policy might block telemetry. Sam, can you confirm?
Sam: Security: KMS for tenant keys must be in place before private logs are enabled. I'll review the KMS policy today. Also need an audit of dataflow to telemetry. If prewarm touches KV cache with real tenant data we need pseudonymization.
Olivia: Good call. Action: Priya to add prewarm with synthetic prompts unless Sam signs the KMS audit.
Priya: OK — will add synthetic prewarm in canary config. If Sam approves KMS by EOD Monday, we switch to tenant-aware priming.
Mateo: Autoscale policy draft:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min: 2
  target_qps_per_gpu: 250
  burst_capacity: 1.5x
  prewarm: true
```
I can open a PR to infra with numbers.
Jin: I'll provision the quota for dedicated pool after PR merges. Need ETA on PR — Mateo?
Mateo: PR by EOD today.
Sam: KMS audit: I'm starting now. Primary blockers to signoff: HSM availability SLA and key rotation procedures. Expect decision by Monday 4pm PT.
Sasha: I'll coordinate Helios comms for the VIP tenants about a small canary window and failure modes.
Olivia: Launch criteria (minimal): 1) infra pool provisioned, 2) runtime prewarm in synthetic mode, 3) KMS signoff or explicit pseudonymization, 4) telemetry ingestion validated, 5) rollback plan documented.
Priya: Agree. Suggest adding an eval run on the canary prompts with latency and quality baselines.
Olivia: Added. Who will own post-launch rollback runbook?
Mateo: I'll draft the runbook (routing fallback to smaller model + traffic cutover steps).
Jin: Ops alerting: will set an SLO dashboard for p50/p95/p99 and cost per token.
Sam: Security will add a monitoring checklist for anomalous access patterns tied to tenant keys.
Olivia: Great. Quick summary of owners: Mateo (infra + runbook), Priya (runtime + prewarm), Jin (quota + ops dashboards), Sam (security/KMS), Sasha (customer comms). I'll track in the tracker.
Sasha: +1. I'll ping Helios CSM to schedule a brief window Tue morning.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: canary-start -> 2024-03-26T15:00:00Z (automated). :rocket:
Olivia: Thanks team — let's reconvene Monday 10am PT if any of the signoffs slip. :eyes:
